root_cause: The candidate rendered and all browser gates passed, but the conservative Node-side motion-token scanner flagged a viewport initial-scale attribute, one-line CSS declarations, and two raw alpha opacity values.
smallest_fix: Remove initial-scale from the viewport metadata, put tokenized motion declarations on separate lines, replace non-token alpha opacity values with the visible token, and use the delay-none token in the reduced-motion rule.
scope: V0 candidate only; no source registry, Wanaka artifact, human decision, or lifecycle contract changes.
verification_plan: rebuild the local capture manifest against the new candidate hash
